SELECT f.follow_id, f.record_id, f.pet_id, f.client_id, f.follow_type, f.content, f.result, f.plan_time, f.follow_time, f.status, f.follow_by, f.note, f.create_time, p.pet_name, c.client_name, r.diagnosis FROM follow_up f LEFT JOIN pet p ON f.pet_id = p.pet_id LEFT JOIN client c ON f.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN medical_record r ON f.record_id = r.record_id
AND f.status = #{status}
AND (p.pet_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{seaName}, '%') OR c.client_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{seaName}, '%'))
ORDER BY f.status ASC, f.plan_time ASC, f.follow_id DESC
